speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
question: All is got from the One container — yet the self joins Thee not?
premises: From the One container, all is got through the self, from You (sarvavastuni ca yaikanidhānāt svātmanas tvad akhilaṃ kila labhyam).
Yet this own self of mine joins Thee not (asya me punar asau nijā ātmā na tvam eva ghaṭase).
inference: Universal attainment, personal non-joining: all comes through the self, yet the self stays apart.
uncertainties: nijā (fem.) + tām (her) figure the self as feminine before the Lord; paramās segmentation is open (supreme ones? be supreme?); L2's 'Her' is conjectural — needs Kṣemarāja Vivṛti.
